messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high CPU usage detected in preproc pool (k8s: inference/preproc). Spike started at 03:14 UTC. >50% of preproc pods restarting in last 5m. auto-page: @elena (oncall)

elena (oncall): acked — joining. any service degradation reported?

alex: seeing a big spike in tokenizer latency + pod OOMs. grafana: /d/grafana/preproc?panel=tokenizer_cpu shows CPU 95% -> 100% and restart count ramp. link: https://grafana.company.internal/d/preproc-tokenizer

maria: logs from preproc show repeated OOMKilled and an oom-killer trace on node-23. Also a handful of CUDA errors on gpu nodes but main impact is CPU preproc pods on CPU-only nodes. snippet from pod:```
[2026-03-15T03:12:44Z] java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: GC overhead limit exceeded
Container terminated with status OOMKilled
```

rohit: grabbing kubectl output now — copying critical lines:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | egrep "preproc|node-23"
preproc-5fd8cc7b9-abcde   0/1 OOMKilled   0         3m   10.0.23.45   node-23
preproc-5fd8cc7b9-fghij   1/1 Running    0         12m  10.0.24.12   node-19
```

rohit: dmesg on node-23 shows oom_reaper + kill process:```
[    1023.456789] Out of memory: Killed process 21234 (preproc) total-vm:123456kB, anon-rss:112000kB, file-rss:0kB
[    1023.457000] oom_reaper: reaped process 21234 (preproc)
```

alex: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) scale preproc replicas to absorb spike 2) cordon + drain node-23 to stop flapping 3) temporarily enable gateway-level rate limit on heavy prompt routes 4) revert any recent preproc config changes (if any).

maria: agreed. customer impact: we have elevated 502/503 for ~4% of requests to hosted inference in last 10m, concentrated on model endpoints that hit preproc path. Support notified, incidents page updated.

elena (oncall): executing mitigations now — will scale and cordon.

sre-runbook-bot: RUNBOOK STEP: scale deployment -> `kubectl scale deploy/preproc -n inference --replicas=8`

rohit: scaling now.```
kubectl scale deploy/preproc -n inference --replicas=8
HorizontalScalingDeployment(preproc): scaling from 3 to 8
```

rohit: cordoning node-23 and starting drain (graceful):
```
kubectl cordon node-23
kubectl drain node-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

alex: also patching preproc resource limits/requests temporarily to avoid OOMs while we investigate. patch applied to increase cpu request from 500m -> 1:```
kubectl patch deploy preproc -n inference --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/cpu","value":"1"}]'
```

maria: gateway rate limit applied for heavy-prompt route: 5r/s global, burst=10. This should throttle the thundering herd of long prompts that were triggering long preproc CPU runs.

elena (oncall): after scale+patch+rate-limit we're seeing restart count stabilizing. new metric snapshot: preproc OOMs down to 2/min -> 0/min, CPU utilization now ~65%.

rohit: note — some GPU nodes reported a single CUDA error earlier (driver reported page fault) but containers on those nodes remained running. filing follow-up with infra to check GPU driver telemetry.

samir: good containment. action items for next hour: 1) run preproc heap / memory profiling on a repro pod 2) capture full core dumps for OOM pods 3) check recent deploys or bunling changes to tokenization library 4) evaluate whether requests can be short-circuited earlier to reduce CPU work.

elena (oncall): handing off to @samir for next steps and postmortem ownership. I'll remain available for ~30m then hand to @rohit for overnight coverage.

samir: acknowledged — taking postmortem ownership. will coordinate diffs and heap profiles. tagging @eng-ml to triage tokenizer changes.

maria: support note prepared and sent to affected customers (IDs redacted here) with ETA ~1h for full recovery and a note about degraded throughput.

elena (oncall): final checklist before handoff to @rohit:
- [x] scale replicas -> 8
- [x] cordon+drain flaky node-23
- [x] increase cpu request/limits on preproc
- [x] gateway rate limiting applied
- [x] support notified
- [ ] collect heap/core dumps (samir)

rohit: taking over on-call at 04:00 UTC. will monitor OOM count, restart count, and customer 5xx rate. if OOMs reappear, next step is to roll back tokenizer library to previous known-safe tag.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied. Impact: partial degradation for ~45 minutes, ~4% elevated 5xx across hosted inference. Postmortem owner: samir. Handoff: rohit (night).

elena (oncall): thanks team — nice rapid response. We'll follow up with a detailed postmortem and remediation plan (limits, autoscaling policies, improved tokenization guards). :rotating_light: :white_check_mark:
